title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability… (CVE-2026-132719)
description: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. The issue is linked to the includes/parser/Sanitizer.php file. Affected versions include MediaWiki 1.43.0 before 1.43.12, 1.45.0 before 1.45.7, 1.46.0 before 1.46.3, and version 1.47. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS 5.3 score.
